approach: Hand-written C# port of both Nokia J2ME games, checked tick by tick against traces of the original bytecode.
notes: Both games are playable end to end: platformer logic, rendering, menus, hall of fame, bonus minigame and sound. Validated with 37 golden state traces (17 + 20) and 19 rendered frame sets, all identical to the original. Adds gamepad and key remapping, mouse menus, shader filters (xBRZ, ScaleFX, CRT, LCD), LCD ghosting and a debug menu with hitbox wireframes. Mod support is planned.
